name: Team Site (Group-Connected)
description: Group-connected SharePoint Team site provisioned at /teams/<url>. The site name becomes the M365 group display name and inherits the Entra group naming policy.

fields.name: SiteName
fields.tip: URL name: lowercase, hyphenated, no spaces. Group-connected sites inherit the M365 group naming policy (see Teams category). Total file path stays under 400 chars — keep URLs short.
